_STATUS: SUPERSEDED IN PART by docs/protocol-ledger.md, which is the authoritative record as of the 2026-09-22 audit. This file is still useful as the MACHINE-READABLE census of request/response classes (the `requests` and `responses` arrays are generated by scripts/extract_protocol.py). Where the two disagree, the ledger wins.
_CORRECTED_2026_09_22: handshake_flow preHandshake/sendRSAPublic: v4/w4 frames have NO leading protocol-type byte. They are [u16le marker][u8 count][u8 index][chunk]. Fixed below.
handshake_flow handshakeGetSSN: x2's versionName is NOT the trailing bytes after the NUL; it is chr(byte@59) + '%04d' % u24le@60. Fixed below.
handshake_flow firstHandshake: k3 IS byte-exact; the old 'STRONGLY INFERRED, not byte-exact' assessment is withdrawn. Fixed below.
w$a/w$c direction: w$c is the host->device (request) table, w$a the device->host (response) table. See ledger section 3.
File-list entries begin at offset 11, not 9; the stride is 8/9/10 by portVersion; scene is at +8 and attribute at +9. See ledger section 5.6.
Bulk file data is protocol type 2, not 4. Type 4 is the BLE rate test (opcode 101). See ledger sections 5.8 and 5.11.
l3's 3-byte version field is LITTLE-endian. See ledger section 5.5.
n7's field at offset 7 is named `timezone`, and both syncTime timezone fields are signed int8. See ledger section 5.2.
vendor: TinnoTech Pen BLE SDK, as shipped by Plaud

post_bind_get_storage.limitation: Response field values require a runtime trace or hardware; structural parser offsets are confirmed. n6 is the sole a()==6 class (no alias). 27-byte response exceeds default ATT MTU payload; hardware transfer of >20 B control responses is UNKNOWN.

mtu_negotiation.source: z/z$c bytecode: z.f(I) calls BluetoothGatt.requestMtu with field m (default 255, set on connect in onConnectionStateChange); onMtuChanged stores the negotiated value and forwards (mtu, status) to listener z$e.a(II)
mtu_negotiation.value: Android SDK requests MTU 255 on every STATE_CONNECTED; no app-layer control-frame reassembly exists (single getValue() byte[] per notification to the registered callback; no accumulation buffers in z/z$c)
mtu_negotiation.limitation: Device-side MTU acceptance is firmware behavior, invisible in app artifacts. 27-byte StorageRsp arrives as one notification iff negotiated MTU >= 30. iOS has no code-level MTU evidence (binary); CoreBluetooth negotiates automatically.

post_bind_sync_time.source: connection-time syncTime()V -> t3.m -> q.m/m7/n7 bytecode; bleTimeSync consumers in both templates
post_bind_sync_time.limitation: Request values are runtime-dependent (wall clock + local timezone); emulator uses fixed values. Response stamp semantics (echo vs device clock) UNKNOWN. NOT hardware or SDK-integration validated.

lifecycle_post_bind.value: iOS: scanning->connecting->GATT-connected(case 1, not success)->handshake stages->bleBind(0)->refreshDeviceInfo(getState+getStorage)->blePenState. Android: Connected->syncTime->getVersion->refreshDeviceInfo(getChargingState+getStorage)->refreshRecordState->checkFirmwareUpdate->delayed getFileList.
lifecycle_post_bind.limitation: Handshake frame bytes (RSA) not recovered; emulator lifecycle caps at CONNECTED. NOT hardware or SDK-integration validated.

charging_facade_zero_packet.source: PlaudDeviceAgent.getChargingState()V + q.b()Z/q.c()I bytecode: synchronous cached-field reads forwarded to listener.bleChargingState; no request construction, no z.a send
charging_facade_zero_packet.value: getChargingState generates zero BLE packets. Battery cache is fed by device-pushed BattStatusRsp (p, opcode 9) parsed in the q$f device-event dispatcher. iOS never calls the poll; both platforms consume pushed blePowerChange/bleChargingState.
charging_facade_zero_packet.limitation: Exact push trigger mapping inside the q$f dispatcher not fully mapped; battery values remain future work.

handshake_reconstruction.source: q.n/q.a0/q.a/q.d0 drivers, v4/w4/k3/j3/l3/x2/m7/n7/z7/q5/z$c bytecode; partner endpoint paths; both templates' lifecycle
handshake_reconstruction.value: preHandshake v4 (FE10/FE20, SN-sig chunks) -> secret 0xFE12 (RSA-decrypt 56B params+PLAUD.AI check) -> sendRSAPublic w4 (pubkey chunks) -> firstHandshake k3 (opcodes {1,2}) -> type-word dispatch (1: l3 legacy, 2: x2 SSN -> q.d0 j3) -> l3.status==0 -> syncTime -> bleBind(0). R2 implements framing codecs + l3/x2 parsers + dispatch rule with synthetic vectors only.
handshake_reconstruction.limitation: RSA pair, SN signature, SN, token, session keys all account/hardware-issued: no bind producible. k3/j3 request bytes not byte-exact (obfuscated body + token). z7/WifiCloseRsp shares a()==4 but has no AAR call-site (w7 path). Post-bind notifications are ChaCha20 ciphertexts: R1a-R1c reconstruct the inner plaintext layer. NOT hardware or SDK-integration validated.

file_sync_forensics.confidence_dynamics: STRONGLY INFERRED where stated; data-header semantics HYPOTHESIS
file_sync_forensics.value: syncFile=facade op (task+receivers+y6 op28, listens {28,29}); s6 HEAD u32+u8 / t6 TAIL u32+u16-forwarded-unverified; TWO data families (q$a session-gated [01|02][session][offset][code][data] + EMPTY_PACKAGE/loss-resend/HEAD/TAIL branches; q.a(v3) type-4 with byte[1] puzzle); g4 ByteBuffer assembler ('ogg2opus'); getFileList=p2 op26 (u32+u32+u8) -> s5 multi-frame accumulation -> q2 entries -> BleFile; b5 op22 = resumeRecord, c5 its response; opcode-22 alias (b8 Wi-Fi / c5 resume) resolved by registration mechanism (distinct lambdas per registration); OggUtils.putPkg + OpusUtils.decode chain.
file_sync_forensics.limitation: Data-header byte[1] dual role unresolved. q$a-vs-q.a(v3) family relation UNKNOWN. t6 u16 forwarded, never compared (UNVERIFIED, not validated CRC). q2 terminal frame UNKNOWN. s5.e/flag writers unmapped. Resume handshake unmapped. Audio handoffs partially mapped. NOT hardware or SDK-integration validated.

file_sync_emulator_bounds.value: R3 emulator (transfer.py + peripheral dispatch): y6 starts/replaces session and emits HEAD+DATA+TAIL at once (32B payloads); p2 answered with the full synthetic table (page/flag parsed but inert); b5 answered with session/scene echoed + fixed fields; TAIL crc passes through unvalidated; malformed shapes rejected explicitly. Unknown fields never alter behavior.
file_sync_emulator_bounds.limitation: Pacing (full sequence at once), 32B payload size, session replacement, and full-table responses are harness choices. No auth, no bind, no real-device compatibility. R3 NOT frozen.

integrity: CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE helper exists; control-frame coverage and wire byte order unknown

handshake_flow.protocol_type: none on the wire; v4 declares 1 but that value never reaches it
handshake_flow.layout: [u16le marker][u8 chunk_count][u8 chunk_index][chunk <=100B]. NO protocol-type byte: v4.enPkg overrides enPkg and never calls packHead, and the receive side reads the marker with b(value,0) -- a u16 at offset ZERO. count=(len+99)//100. Payload is Base64.decode(snSignature, NO_WRAP). CORRECTED 2026-09-22 (the previous entry prepended a fabricated 0x01).
handshake_flow.response: 0xFE11 selects sendRSAPublic; 0xFE12 carries encrypted secret chunks
handshake_flow.success: all chunks acknowledged and response marker recognized

handshake_flow.layout: [u16le 0xFE12][u8 chunk_count][u8 chunk_index][<=100 bytes of the RSA public key as PEM TEXT]. NO protocol-type byte, same as v4. CORRECTED 2026-09-22.
handshake_flow.response: per-chunk callback; final response is processed as the next handshake marker

handshake_flow.layout: k3: [01][01 00][u8 constant 0x02][u8 z.h() -- stubbed to 0][u8 stage, ONLY when portVersion>=3][token right-padded with ASCII '0' to 32 chars when portVersion>=9 else 16], then u4.b() trims the trailing zero run. 22 bytes (pv 3..8) or 38 (pv>=9). j3 appends [8B devToken zero-padded][u8 len(userName)][userName]. k3's 4th ctor arg (portVersion) is a LAYOUT SELECTOR and never reaches the wire. CORRECTED 2026-09-22: k3 IS byte-exact; only the credential VALUES are unavailable.
handshake_flow.response: l3 opcode 1 for legacy response, or x2 opcode 2 for SSN response
handshake_flow.success: l3.status == 0, or x2 parses an SSN
handshake_flow.next: legacy -> syncTime; x2 -> handshakeGetSSN then twoHandshake
handshake_flow.confidence: DIRECT (layout); credential values are cloud-issued and unavailable offline

handshake_flow.request_class: none; response is emitted by the first-handshake exchange
handshake_flow.response: x2 (GetSsnRsp) opcode 2: ASCII SSN from offset 3 to the first NUL strictly before offset 59 (28 ASCII zeros when none is found); versionName = chr(byte@59) + '%04d' % u24le@60, from FIXED offsets, e.g. 'V0123'. Full frame 63 bytes. CORRECTED 2026-09-22 (was 'trailing bytes after the NUL').
handshake_flow.success: x2 constructor accepts the response and returns SSN

handshake_flow.layout: same j3 extended layout as firstHandshake; token/user fields are supplied from agent state
[u8 type=1][u16le 4][u32le Unix seconds][u8 timezone hours][u8 timezone minutes] (9 bytes; corrected 2026-09-21, was u24)
handshake_flow.response: n7 (TimeSyncRsp) opcode 4: u32le stamp at offset 3, u8 raw7 at offset 7 (parsed but unnamed), optional bool hasStatistics at offset 8
handshake_flow.success: n7 parses; retries up to three attempts on send/parse failure
handshake_flow.next: connected callback, then getState/getStorage and settings reads

notes: real class name GetStateRsp from the z2.toString literal; toString maps state<-b, privacyEnable<-c, keyState<-e, usbState<-f, findMyState<-g, scene<-j, sessionId<-k

d/e@8 recovered 2026-09-21 from z2<init> bytecode (jawa, no decompiler): d=u8@8, e=(u8@8)==1, gated on length>=9. extract_protocol.py missed them; its min_length heuristic also reported the first <N guard (9) rather than the unconditional prefix (8).
guard chain: len>=9 -> d,e@8; len>=10 -> f@9; len>=15 -> j@10,k@11; len>=16 -> g@15; len>=17 -> h@16; len>=18 -> i@17; shorter frames return early with fewer fields

z7 (WifiCloseRsp, family m) shares a()==4 but has no constructor call-site in the shipped AAR and is built in w7 (Wi-Fi path): no BLE-path ambiguity; q.m routing via outstanding-request callback constructs n7 in q.X
